result.note: PHASE-S29's citation_accuracy_only gap is now closed: PRIN-001 is cited by its real historical label and real source phases without the false E23 registration claim, and the citation now correctly points to its real, formal home in the adopted PHASE-SSI-S4/S9 Principle. cause.root_cause_summary: PHASE-SSI-S0's foundation model cited a real, consistently-used informal label (PRIN-001) alongside a plausible-looking but incorrect formal registration claim ("(E23)") -- the underlying concept was always real and, by the time S29 checked, already independently formalized elsewhere (PHASE-SSI-S4/S9); only the citation text itself was wrong.

lesson: A citation-accuracy gap should be closed with the smallest possible edit: keep the real historical label intact, remove only the false attribution, and point to where the concept is actually, formally registered today -- never invent a new registration to "fix" an old one, and never let closing one small citation ripple into touching unrelated fields or artifacts.
